Field incident: during the 24H soak, empty files named BLOCKED and M-backtick appeared at saipen_home root; the only SAIPEN process could not have written them. Writer identified: Claude Code host hooks run cmd.exe with single-slash switches through Git Bash; MSYS rewrites /d and /c into drive paths, cmd.exe starts INTERACTIVE and executes the hook's JSON payload (the text that was read, e.g. 'goal_tickets N-> M' creating a file named M) as commands in the session cwd. SAIPEN cannot change host config; fix is read-only detection: host_hooks.stray_hint parses the host settings and names the culprit hook; validate.py attaches the hint to the root-file-set FAIL so the cause is attached to the refusal. Applied to main (host_hooks.py, validate.py +7, test).
